problems: 768/390: Menu lacks an Escape handler; after opening it with keyboard or touch, Escape leaves it expanded. This is a reproducible keyboard interaction omission.

Accessibility polish remains: the supplied desktop axe probe reports a serious contrast violation, form validation uses one alert without field-level aria-invalid association, and there is no clear/delete saved-entry control.

reason: B's chart and controls are substantially more usable on a phone, and its labelled model exposes peak top-ups and shortages while keeping readable textual alternatives. Both load locally and handle ordinary form errors well; I would revisit this choice after A recomposes its hourly strip and B fixes menu dismissal and reconciles the shortage state with its promise.
